# Fallout 76 Patch Notes April 30, 2024 (Patch 51)

![Fallout 76 Patch Notes April 30, 2024 (Patch 51)](/uploads/346_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

Today we release our latest update for Fallout 76, which includes various bug fixes and general improvements. Read on to familiarize yourself with the full patch notes.UPDATE VERSION 1.7.11.12 AND DOWNLOAD SIZESHere you can find out the download size of today's update on the respective platform:

**PC (Steam)**: 12.1 GB
**PC (Microsoft Store)**: 19.8 GB
**Xbox**: 23.1GB
**PlayStation**: 19.2GB

BUG FIXES

- Fixed a bug that caused power armor entries to appear in English instead of the selected text language.
- Fixed a bug that caused the Garrahan Mining poster to be missing from Rusty Pick and Camden Park.
**Occasions**: Fixed a bug that caused the quest to disappear after logging in again.- The Depths of Space Alien Jetpack can now properly be crafted for the T-51 Power Armor.
- Fixed a bug that prevented the Cremator from being listed on Legendary Exchange machines.
- Fixed a bug that allowed Abbie Russo to ask a question about Vin, which did not correctly reflect the outcome of the Sins of the Father quest.
- Anyone who had already unlocked the poker and blackjack tables should now be able to craft them.
**The Sins of the Father**: The quest will no longer be blocked if a dialogue scene between Abbie and Antonio is canceled at a certain point.
**The Sins of the Father**: Fixed a bug that could prevent Antonio from speaking to the player character.- The Brahmin Flour Advertisement should now be craftable and linked to the correct materials.
- Added the designated walls and windows to the Rustic Helvetia C.A.M.P. kit.
- The hotkeys for the favorites menu can now be used when the selection wheel is displayed.
- Fixed an issue where gold bullion vendors Regs and Smiley were sometimes unavailable after completing Secrets Revealed.
- Tesla Rifles are now correctly rewarded in the Battle Robot event.
- The Father Frost Helmet should now have standard T-45 attributes, description, weight and tiers.
- The fancy revolver should now display correctly with its unique fancy paint job.
- Fixed a bug that prevented small gifts from containing contextual ammo.
- Fixed a bug that prevented weather stations from being placed in C.A.M.P.s that were too close to public workshops.
- The Trendy Home kitchen sink can now be attached to other Trendy Home items on a foundation.
**Secrets Revealed**: Fixed an issue where Meg, Gail, Ra-Ra, Johnny and Lou would sometimes not be in Crater Core after completing the quest.- The lights on the Devil Wing Jetpack now work correctly.
- Pollinators no longer receive the group regeneration effect during daily operations.
- Fixed issues with several paint schemes that caused the dynamic name of modified power armor pieces to no longer update.
- The bug that caused random items in the Cryo Fridge to be sold at the merchant for 0 caps should be fixed.
- The Big Boss advertising poster no longer turns into a Mothman poster when destroyed.
- When comparing possible mods and current equipment, the rate of fire increase or decrease is now indicated by arrows.
- Storytime is now correctly removed from Pip-Boy when Miss Nanny is killed.
- Fixed a bug that prevented Buried Treasure from appearing correctly
